create.name: Tibetisches Zentrum Hamburg
create.bio:
The Tibetisches Zentrum is a Tibetan Buddhist association in Hamburg that teaches in German, with the Dalai Lama as its patron since 1988. It works from three sites: a temple and stupa garden in Hamburg-Berne, a city venue in central Hamburg, and Semkye Ling, a country meditation house in the Lüneburg Heath near Schneverdingen, where ordained nuns live and where the Dalai Lama stayed for ten days in 1998. Its resident teacher is Geshe Pema Samten, alongside other Tibetan geshes and a group of Western teachers and translators.

Its best-known programme is the Systematic Study of Buddhism, a part-time course designed by its late spiritual director Geshe Thubten Ngawang on the model of Tibetan monastic universities, run since 1988 and followed by more than 2,500 people, in Hamburg or by livestream. Since 2020 it has also offered a six-year full-time course. Each year brings eighty or so further seminars, retreats and initiations, plus free open meditations several evenings a week. The YouTube channel, active since 2009, carries these sessions: Monday morning practice, Tuesday meditations, Friday talks with meditation, and a podcast for younger listeners.

courses.title: Systematisches Studium des Buddhismus
courses.description: A part-time, multi-year study of Buddhist philosophy and practice in German, modelled on the Tibetan monastic curriculum, taken in Hamburg or online by livestream, with study circles, tutors and optional exams.

courses.title: Neujahrs-Initiation Vajrasattva
courses.description: A New Year's Day initiation into the Vajrasattva practice given by Geshe Pema Samten in Hamburg-Berne, with German translation.

courses.title: Meditationshaus Semkye Ling: Seminare und Klausuren
courses.description: The centre's rural meditation house in the Lüneburg Heath hosts seminars for beginners and experienced students, guided group retreats and solitary retreats in separate cabins.

free_resources.title: Offene Meditationen und Praxisangebot
free_resources.description: Open meditation sessions in Hamburg and at Semkye Ling, needing no experience and offered for donations, most also streamed live.

free_resources.title: Meditationserklärungen und Texte
free_resources.description: Meditation instructions, guided recordings and prayer texts to download and use at home, including a four-week mindfulness training by Oliver Petersen.
